purpose: Canonical cross-link layer for Super Souls explicitly established as PQ rewards by the repository's normalized PQ reward maps.
source_policy: Only index a Super Soul when the current repository reward layer explicitly names it. Empty or missing PQ soul arrays are unresolved rather than negative claims.

coverage_notes: This is an acquisition cross-link layer, not yet the complete Super Soul master database.
PQ41-186 is intentionally represented only where the normalized PQ layer explicitly established a Super Soul.
The source layer currently leaves several PQ ranges unresolved, especially parts of PQ41-80 and individual later quests.
Duplicate acquisition relationships are preserved as multiple PQ references rather than deduplicated away.
Effect text, Limit Burst data, activation conditions, stat magnitudes, and verification dates belong in the forthcoming Super Soul master records.
